problems.title: Does this sound familiar?
problems.subtitle: If the situations below happen every week at your company, there is a good chance they can be automated.
items: An invoice comes in twice, through two channels - someone has to catch the duplicate before it gets booked twice.
A lead sits in the inbox for half a day while the prospect messages three competitors instead.
Someone re-types the same data from one system into another, every month.
Documents circulate by email and nobody knows whose desk the approval is stuck on.

services.title: What I actually automate
services.subtitle: From a single process to full system integrations and AI agents.

service1.title: Workflow automation
service1.desc: I connect systems, apps and people into one flow. Data entered once ends up wherever it's needed - no copying, no email attachments, no guessing who did what. Works well for purchase approvals, invoice sign-off, or onboarding a new employee.

service2.title: Document workflow automation
service2.desc: Automatic deduplication and routing of incoming documents across departments - no more double-booked entries. Includes monitoring of the underlying integrations, with an alert before a process silently breaks mid-day.

service3.title: System integration
service3.desc: I connect ERP, CRM, email and your warehouse into one ecosystem with automatic data exchange, no monthly spreadsheet export. Data updates on both sides in near real time, so sales and accounting see the same numbers.

service4.title: Training & consulting
service4.desc: I teach your team to spot which processes are worth automating. Available with public co-funding covering up to 83% of the cost. The workshop ends with a concrete, ready-to-build list of processes for your company.

service5.title: Task automation (RPA)
service5.desc: A software robot takes over repetitive work inside your existing systems - clicking, copying and filling forms exactly like a person, minus the breaks. Especially useful where a system has no API, like older accounting software.

service6.title: Care & hosting
service6.desc: I monitor and fix deployed automations. Left unattended, they quietly break the moment a connected system changes. Care includes a monthly report on what ran and how much time it saved.

service7.title: AI agents
service7.desc: I build AI assistants for document analysis, customer support and data monitoring - they take the first pass at high volumes of information, answering from your own documentation and handing off harder cases to a person.

faq.q1: How long does an implementation take?
faq.a1: A simple process takes 1–2 weeks. A more complex one, integrating several systems, takes 3–4 weeks. I always start with whatever proves value fastest.

faq.a4: Automation left unattended eventually breaks as the systems around it change. I offer a monthly care plan to keep it running.
faq.q5: Who actually does the work - a company or one person?

workflow.subtitle: I connect systems, apps and people into one coherent, automated process.
workflow.service_type: Workflow automation with n8n and Make.com
workflow.cta_subtitle: Book a free call and show me your processes.
workflow.s1_p1: Workflow automation is designing and implementing flows that connect different systems, apps and teams into one coherent, automated process. Instead of manually passing data between applications, your systems talk to each other automatically.
workflow.s1_p2: In practice, data entered once in one place ends up wherever it's needed - no copy-pasting, no email attachments, no "has someone already done this?".
benefits: Eliminates manual data handoffs between systems
Cuts process completion time by 60–80%
Full visibility into the status of every task

Easy to extend as the company grows

workflow.faq_title: Frequently asked questions about n8n implementation

faq.q: How much does an n8n implementation cost?
faq.a: The price of n8n implementation depends on the number of processes and integrations - a single workflow starts at $1,475. I'll give you an exact quote after we talk through your systems.

faq.q: How is n8n different from Zapier?
faq.a: n8n is an open-source alternative to Zapier - it can be self-hosted, which lowers the cost at high volume and gives you full control over your data.

faq.q: Do I need an n8n specialist, or can I build it myself?
faq.a: Simple automations can be built on your own. I step in as an n8n consultant when a process spans several systems, needs error handling, or requires an integration with no ready-made connector.

integration.h1: System integration – connecting ERP, CRM and databases
integration.subtitle: I build bridges between your systems, creating one coherent ecosystem with automatic data exchange.
integration.cta_subtitle: Describe your systems and I'll propose the right connection.
integration.s1_p1: 5–50 person companies typically run a handful of applications: ERP, CRM, email, warehouse, sales platform. Without integration, someone manually moves data between them, which creates errors, delays and frustration.
integration.s1_p2: I connect your systems through APIs, webhooks and dedicated middleware so data flows automatically, in real time - no more monthly export to a spreadsheet.
benefits: Eliminates manual re-entry of data
Data stays current across every system
Fewer errors and duplicates
Faster flow of information and decisions
One consistent customer view for the whole team
integration.cena_text: A simple integration between two systems fits the START package from $1,475; multi-system integrations fall under the CORE package from $3,725.

ai.subtitle: I build AI assistants that analyze documents, answer customer questions and keep an eye on your data.
ai.cta_title: Ready for an AI agent at your company?
ai.cta_subtitle: Let's find out which process would benefit most from an AI agent.
ai.s1_title: What an AI agent actually does
ai.s1_p1: Unlike a plain RPA robot, an AI agent understands the content of a document or question rather than just clicking predefined spots. It can read an invoice in any format, answer a customer in natural language, or summarize a long document.
ai.s1_p2: It doesn't replace the expert in your company. It takes the first pass at a large volume of data - documents, messages, questions - and only passes forward what actually needs a human decision.
ai.cena_text: A simple AI agent wired into one process fits the CORE package from $3,725; a full self-hosted deployment with its own knowledge base falls under the TRANSFORMACJA package from $7,250.

opieka.subtitle: I monitor, fix and grow your deployed automations on a self-hosted n8n server in the EU, GDPR-compliant - before they stop working.

opieka.cta_title: Already have an automation and need ongoing care?
opieka.cta_subtitle: I'll check how it's running today and suggest the right level of care.
opieka.s1_p1: Automation isn't a one-and-done deployment. The systems it talks to change their interfaces and APIs, vendors update their platforms, and your company grows and adds new exceptions to the rule. Without care, a process quietly breaks after a while - and nobody notices until data starts going missing.
opieka.s1_p2: Care means monitoring, a fast response to failures, and maintaining the server the automation runs on - so the investment in building it doesn't go to waste after six months.
